direction.premise: A laboratory for independently saved Q tables and real neural policies, now including PPO-Clip learning on collected on-policy experience.
direction.composition: A dominant world viewport paired with one compact control rail. A single algorithm selector reveals whether the saved brain is a Q table or an MLP, with no speculative training statistics.
direction.shapeLanguage: Sharp laboratory tiles and small squared control clusters frame the simulation; specimen identities use initials in dark mineral-green tiles rather than decorative character portraits.
direction.surfaceAndMaterial: Flat opaque cell pigments retain the source renderer. Muted teal instrument metal surrounds a near-black culture surface without glass effects.
direction.paletteLogic: Blue marks the learner and spawn, green marks the goal, red the harmful cells, and yellow the rewards. Grey walls preserve legibility over a dark empty grid.
direction.typography: System sans-serif labels keep controls legible at compact sizes. The product name is a small bench label rather than a decorative title.
direction.signature: Select PPO in the same petri-dish world and watch the policy learn across batches without overwriting the historic Q or actor–critic brain.
direction.distinction: Unlike the video processing console or turn-based board, PetriForge makes the live world primary, backed by a persistent library of independently trained policy specimens.

architecture.primaryVerb: Select a learning algorithm, run real simulation episodes, pause/stop, inspect the learned brain, compare archived agents and validate on unseen scenarios.
architecture.physicalFeedback: Policy gradients update true stored weights; rollouts, KL divergence and optimization rounds reflect actual computation, never decorative charts.
architecture.spatialRationale: The previous stage's field-first desktop and stacked portrait layout remains intact; an algorithm row appears only when a grid experiment is selected, avoiding controls for algorithms unsupported by other worlds.

comparisons.interactionDifference: fog-of-conquest uses scene-zoom navigation; PetriForge exposes cell brushes, undo, procedural maps and a separately stepped learning worker.

comparisons.interactionDifference: In Black Bazaar participants make economic decisions. PetriForge draws map geometry then runs a live learning agent, with optional diagnostics outside the simulation.

comparisons.interactionDifference: Blockies places and moves blocks during a party match; PetriForge edits a world, steps agent simulation and observes training results.

comparisons.spatialDifference: «Тихий кадр» организует монтажно-аудиоаналитическую рабочую поверхность с плеером и боковыми переключателями; PetriForge отдаёт центр постоянно активной игровой симуляции и оставляет настройки вне сцены.
comparisons.interactionDifference: «Тихий кадр» обрабатывает загруженный файл и переключает звуковые дорожки; в PetriForge пользователь запускает серии самостоятельных испытаний агента, сохраняет мозги и сравнивает поведение.

comparisons.spatialDifference: «Шесть ходов» показывает компактную настольную сетку с прямым нажатием на клетки; PetriForge использует крупную непрерывную арену, где во время headless-тренировки игровое поле не требует ходов пользователя.
comparisons.interactionDifference: «Шесть ходов» предполагает выбор отдельных допустимых ходов человеком или ИИ; PetriForge автоматически выполняет множество эпизодов, сохраняет экспериментальные модели и воспроизводит действия агента.

production.renderer: Canvas 2D preserves the recovered source cell renderer and exact 30 by 20 simulation without a GPU or external assets.
production.focalAsset: The focal object is the editable cell culture drawn from source rules; a hand-authored SVG dish and cell path provide the install identity.

motion.character: Discrete and immediate: state changes occur on cell boundaries because the learner samples one action at a time.
motion.action: Starting training updates the rail's real progress; a specimen selection loads its actual model; activating perception reveals the agent's sampled neighborhood.
motion.anticipation: The selected tool and tile value expose the pending edit before the pointer touches the culture.
motion.response: PPO collects samples before changing the policy, reports headless-training progress, and persists its own checkpoint after an entire session.
motion.followThrough: The user can replay the latest recorded attempt or test when none exists and can verify cloned skills after reload.
motion.interruption: Training can be stopped; model switches await worker confirmation; the specimen library reports write failures instead of pretending success.
motion.reducedMotion: There are no decorative transitions to remove; discrete cell changes retain all simulation information.

evidence.expectedChange: The blue learner takes one discrete action and the step counter advances by exactly one.
